card.name: Inside Windows and MFC API names
card.fires_on: Partway through Windows API or MFC identifiers in programming documentation, such as InterlockedExchange(Add), PyC(Dialog), CView::(On)Draw. It fires on the piece just before the name finishes.

modes.label: Interlocked function names
modes.description: Inside the name of an atomic Win32 function, just before Add or a size number.
